meta.name: Tastefully Yours
meta.description: Driven to claim top culinary honors, an arrogant heir meets a low-profile but stubborn chef whose recipes astonish him — sparking an unlikely romance.

videos.title: A Taste of Familiarity
videos.overview: On a quest to earn a three-star review, Han Beom-woo traces a copycat of his dish to a humble restaurant—where he clashes with its owner, Mo Yeon-joo.

videos.title: The Stubbornness of Jungjae
videos.overview: Yeon-joo signs a deal with Beom-woo—under certain conditions. They soon fight over every detail, from hiring to plating, until they find their groove.

videos.title: Partially Soaked
videos.overview: As false rumours of Jungjae's failure spread through town, Yeon-joo and Beom-woo hit snag after snag—until a frightening incident shakes the restaurant.

videos.title: Love is Like a Spark
videos.overview: As the Jungjae team preps for the food truck competition, Yeon-joo and Beom-woo clash over their approach—but soon join forces for a shot at victory.

videos.title: Neither Hot nor Cold
videos.overview: After a tender moment between Yeon-joo and Beom-woo, an unexpected figure appears. The Jungjae team prepares for an international wedding tasting.

videos.title: Jungjae Manual
videos.overview: Beom-woo, Jin Myung-sook and Shin Choon-seung struggle to fill Yeon-joo's void when she unexpectedly disappears—until Beom-woo sets out to find her.

videos.title: The Restaurant I Loved
videos.overview: In Japan, Beom-woo and Yeon-joo grow closer as she prepares a recipe for her former boss. Beom-woo confronts Jeon Min about his intentions with Yeon-joo.

videos.title: Scorched Recipe
videos.overview: As Beom-woo scrambles to clean up a mess of his own making, the Jungjae team heads out on a trip—and his feelings for Yeon-joo deepen even more.

videos.title: Imperfect Cooking
videos.overview: The shocking truth shatters Yeon-joo and Beom-woo's relationship, leaving them both devastated. But soon, they receive surprising news about Jungjae.

videos.title: Tastefully Yours
videos.overview: Jungjae goes head-to-head with Motto in a showdown of taste. Can Beom-woo and Yeon-joo overcome their differences to come out on top?
